local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- ==========================================
-- НАСТРОЙКИ
-- ==========================================

local highlightColor = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
local rotationSpeed = 5

local isHighlighting = false
local isAimbotEnabled = false
local highlights = {}

-- ==========================================
-- FLY
-- ==========================================

local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 50

local bodyVelocity
local bodyGyro
local flyConnection

local function startFly()
    if isFlying then
        return
    end

    isFlying = true

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "ModMenuFlyVelocity"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = root

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "ModMenuFlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.Parent = root

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not isFlying then
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if not camera or not root or not root.Parent then
            return
        end

        local direction = Vector3.zero

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            direction += Vector3.yAxis
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            direction -= Vector3.yAxis
        end

        if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            direction = direction.Unit * flySpeed
        end

        bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    isFlying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if bodyVelocity then
        bodyVelocity:Destroy()
        bodyVelocity = nil
    end

    if bodyGyro then
        bodyGyro:Destroy()
        bodyGyro = nil
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- ESP
-- ==========================================

local function addHighlight(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    if highlights[player] then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ModMenuHighlight"
    highlight.FillColor = highlightColor
    highlight.OutlineColor = highlightColor
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = character

    highlights[player] = highlight
end

local function removeHighlight(player)
    if highlights[player] then
        highlights[player]:Destroy()
        highlights[player] = nil
    end
end

local function removeAllHighlights()
    for player, highlight in pairs(highlights) do
        if highlight then
            highlight:Destroy()
        end

        highlights[player] = nil
    end
end

local function toggleHighlights()
    isHighlighting = not isHighlighting

    if isHighlighting then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            addHighlight(player)
        end
    else
        removeAllHighlights()
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- ИГРОКИ / РЕСПАВН
-- ==========================================

local function setupPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if isHighlighting then
            task.wait(0.2)
            addHighlight(player)
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    setupPlayer(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removeHighlight(player)
end)

-- ==========================================
-- AIMBOT
-- ==========================================

local function getNearestEnemy()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not rootPart then
        return nil
    end

    local closestPlayer = nil
    local closestDistance = math.huge

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= LocalPlayer and otherPlayer.Character then

            local otherRoot =
                otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local humanoid =
                otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if otherRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then

                local distance =
                    (otherRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude

                if distance < closestDistance then
                    closestDistance = distance
                    closestPlayer = otherPlayer
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPlayer
end

local cameraConnection

local function startAimbot()
    if cameraConnection then
        cameraConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    cameraConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)

        if not isAimbotEnabled then
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if not camera then
            return
        end

        local targetPlayer = getNearestEnemy()

        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then

            local targetRoot =
                targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if targetRoot then

                local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
                local targetPos = targetRoot.Position

                local offset = targetPos - camPos

                if offset.Magnitude > 0 then

                    local direction = offset.Unit
                    local currentLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector

                    local newLook = currentLook:Lerp(
                        direction,
                        math.clamp(rotationSpeed * dt, 0, 1)
                    )

                    camera.CFrame =
                        CFrame.new(camPos, camPos + newLook)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

startAimbot()

local function GetTarget()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local screenPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    local dist = (screenPos - screenCenter).Magnitude

                    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    elseif getgenv().AimbotMode == "FOV" then
                        if dist <= getgenv().FOVRadius and dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

-- ลูปการทำงานล็อกเป้า

    if getgenv().AimbotEnabled then
        local targetPart = GetTarget()
        if targetPart then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
        end
    end
end)

    }, base)
    local knob = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, base)
    roundify(knob, 20)

    local active
    local function update(p)
        local center = base.AbsolutePosition + base.AbsoluteSize / 2
        local maxR = base.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - 8
        local delta = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center
        if delta.Magnitude > maxR then delta = delta.Unit * maxR end
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X, 0.5, delta.Y)
        callback(Vector2.new(delta.X / maxR, -delta.Y / maxR))
    end
    local function reset()
        active = nil
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        callback(Vector2.zero)
    end

    base.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            active = input
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not active then return end
        if input == active
            or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == active then reset() end
    end))
end

table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not dronePart.Parent then cleanup() return end

    local pos = dronePart.Position
    local gy = groundY(pos)
    local minY = gy and (gy + 0.9) or -math.huge
    local yawIn, vertIn, strafeIn, fwdIn = getInput()
    local inputMag = math.abs(yawIn) + math.abs(vertIn) + math.abs(strafeIn) + math.abs(fwdIn)

    local vel = Vector3.zero
    local tiltF, tiltS = 0, 0

    if flying then
        battery = math.max(0, battery - dt * (0.5 + curVel.Magnitude / 80))
        if battery <= 0 and mode ~= "land" then
            setMode("land")
            toast("🔋 Bateria vazia, a aterrar")
        end
        if inputMag > 0.2 and battery > 0 and (mode == "rth" or mode == "follow" or mode == "land") then
            setMode("manual")
        end

        if mode == "takeoff" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
            if pos.Y - (gy or (pos.Y - 3)) >= 3 then setMode("manual") end
        elseif mode == "manual" then
            yaw = yaw - yawIn * dt * YAW_SPEED
            local horiz = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(
                Vector3.new(strafeIn * SPEED, 0, -fwdIn * SPEED))
            vel = horiz + Vector3.new(0, vertIn * VSPEED, 0)
            tiltF, tiltS = fwdIn, strafeIn
        elseif mode == "rth" then
            local d = homePos() - pos
            local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 3 then
                vel = flat.Unit * math.min(SPEED, flat.Magnitude * 3)
                    + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(d.Y * 2, -VSPEED, VSPEED), 0)
                faceDir(flat, dt)
                tiltF = 0.6
            else
                setMode("land")
            end
        elseif mode == "follow" then
            local d = followPos() - pos
            vel = d * 3
            if vel.Magnitude > SPEED * 1.1 then vel = vel.Unit * SPEED * 1.1 end
            local toPlayer = rootPart.Position - pos
            faceDir(Vector3.new(toPlayer.X, 0, toPlayer.Z), dt)
        elseif mode == "land" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)
            if gy and pos.Y <= minY + 0.15 then
                flying = false
                setMode("manual")
                refreshFlyBtn()
                toast("🛬 Aterrou")
            end
        end

        if pos.Y <= minY and vel.Y < 0 then
            vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        end
    else
        battery = math.min(100, battery + dt * 3)
    end

    curVel = curVel:Lerp(vel, math.min(1, dt * 5))
    curTiltF = curTiltF + (tiltF - curTiltF) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    curTiltS = curTiltS + (tiltS - curTiltS) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    bv.Velocity = curVel
    bg.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-curTiltF * 0.3, 0, -curTiltS * 0.3)

    local targetRotor = flying and (45 + curVel.Magnitude * 0.5) or 0
    rotorSpeed = rotorSpeed + (targetRotor - rotorSpeed) * math.min(1, dt * 3)
    rotorAngle = rotorAngle + rotorSpeed * dt
    for _, r in ipairs(rotors) do
        r.weld.C0 = r.base * CFrame.Angles(0, rotorAngle * r.dir, 0)
    end

    if cameraAttached then
        local gp = dronePart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -0.2, -1.7))
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(gp) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        camera.FieldOfView = fov
    end

    if recording then recTime += dt end

    uiTimer += dt
    if uiTimer >= 0.1 then
        uiTimer = 0
        local alt = gy and (pos.Y - gy) or pos.Y
        local dist = (pos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
        local zoomX = DEFAULT_FOV / fov
        local bat = math.floor(battery)
        local telemetry = string.format("ALT %dm  VEL %d  DIST %dm\n🔋 %d%%  🔍 x%.1f",
            math.floor(alt), math.floor(curVel.Magnitude), math.floor(dist), bat, zoomX)

        local state = flying and modeNames[mode] or (battery < 100 and "A CARREGAR" or "NO CHÃO")
        screenLabel.Text = "📡 " .. state .. "\n" .. telemetry
        hudTelemetry.Text = telemetry

        local bc = battery > 50 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            or battery > 20 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
            or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
        ledStatus.TextColor3 = bc
        ledStatus.Text = string.format("🔋 %d%%  [ DJI RC - LINKED ]", bat)

        if recording then
            local blink = math.floor(recTime * 2) % 2 == 0
            hudRec.Text = string.format("[ %s REC %02d:%02d ]", blink and "🔴" or "⚫",
                math.floor(recTime / 60), math.floor(recTime % 60))
        else
            hudRec.Text = "[ ⏺ STANDBY ]"
        end
    end
end))
